facts.fact: 在教堂里 Abel 的葬礼上，本该致悼词的 Bethany（此前反复走神、向 Abel 家人道歉说自己走神了）说：Abel 在没有别人对她好时善待她、他只是想帮忙、她把他的付出视为理所当然、她逃避了他但他从未放弃她——「而现在，可能正因为这样，他死了。」
facts.anchor: Abel was kind to me when no one else was. He wanted to help. Really that’s all he ever wanted. And I took him for granted. I ran away from him, but Abel never gave up on me. And now, probably because of it, he’s dead.

facts.fact: 葬礼上 Bethany 当众喊出：Abel 死前双眼闪过电视静电（television static），这不是自然死亡；Abel 的母亲向众人坚称那是自然死亡——她的儿子三十四岁（thirty-four）死于心脏病发作。
facts.anchor: “It was a natural death,” Abel’s mom insisted, attempting damage control for the crowd. “My son died of a heart attack at thirty-four years old, and he will be forever missed.”

facts.fact: 葬礼结束后没人载她回家；乘公交回北奥斯汀途中，Bethany 自言自语推理：静电没有手、不能独自毒死人，一定是别人干的——「静电在 Austin 有个盟友」；她认定 Abel 本要帮她、有人确保他帮不成。
facts.anchor: “No. Static can’t do that on its own,” she said. “Static doesn’t have arms, so it can’t poison you. It was someone else. The static has an ally here in Austin.”

facts.fact: Bethany 用藏在旧咖啡罐下的钥匙进了她曾与 Abel 合住的房子，立即发现两个悬浮的静电男人在客厅地毯上方盯着她；她摔门逃走，它们瞬移到路边漂浮着追她。
facts.anchor: She found the keys where they always used to be, under an old coffee tin. She let herself inside and immediately discovered two floating static men waiting for her in the living room, levitating above the carpet, staring right at her.

facts.fact: 静电人把 Bethany 引到 GlobalVill 大楼底层一条变成无限隧道的走廊；霓虹店招凭空成形（「New Releases!」「Horror! Sci-Fi! Romance!」），门前雨棚逐字母拼出「CAPTAIN VIDEO」，静电人穿墙般飘进店门，示意她跟进去。
facts.anchor: So she kept walking forward, and the awning before her began to form its name, one letter at a time. “CA…PT…AIN…VID…EO.”

facts.fact: Bethany 在敞开的店门前停步、靠出声尖叫定住神智抵抗幻象；录像店随即像烧断的保险丝般短路消失，她回到 GlobalVill 总部连接下层卫生间与员工餐厅的真实走廊——静电人不见了，她暂时没让自己被「消失」。
facts.anchor: The video store shorted itself out suddenly, like a blown fuse, and then Bethany was back in the hallway at GlobalVill HQ, the actual, normal-sized hallway that connected the lower-level bathrooms to the staff cafeteria.

facts.fact: 深夜的 GlobalVill 厨房里，CEO Anthony Fischer（Fisch）主动与 Bethany 搭话，认出她是 Trust and Safety 团队里把那名自杀用户举报给当局的内容审核员并自我介绍；随后他与她握手告别。
facts.anchor: “You’re the moderator on our Trust and Safety team who reported that poor suicidal user to the authorities.” He closed the top flap on his briefcase without zipping it up and took a few steps towards her at the kombucha tap. “I’m Anthony Fischer. Fisch, for short. I work here.”

facts.fact: Fisch 离开后，Bethany 意识到让人人都觉得自己「重要」本就是 CEO 的职业戏法，手中的 kombucha 杯随之滑落摔碎；她在厨房发誓：哪怕这是她在这个星球上做的最后一件事，也要让那个 CEO 付出代价。
facts.anchor: In her newfound clarity, there in the GlobalVill kitchen, Bethany promised herself that even if it was the last thing she ever did on this planet, she was going to make that CEO pay.
